food_decision_layer.note: Food requirement logic is a support layer, not a genetic marker pack; manifest pack count is unchanged.

supplement_safety_layer.note: Supplement guidance is a food-first, medication-aware safety layer; genotype can prompt a question but cannot establish need, dose, or safety.

cycle_support_layer.note: Cycle support separates phase physiology, measured hormone timing, symptom timing, medication composition, inherited clotting/contraception review, hormone therapy, pregnancy/postpartum/lactation context, symptom-day support, cycle-linked pain/headache context, cycle-linked nutrition/activity support, and gynecologic escalation from genetic interpretation. Explicit selections take precedence; otherwise populated resource-declared intake/diary context or explicitly supplied profile goals can activate only their resource-mapped domains; profile routing is a relevance hint and does not infer anatomy, identity, hormones, or diagnosis. Cross-pack marker routes connect selected hormone contexts to the cardiovascular thrombophilia markers without duplicating or reclassifying those markers.

pgx_diplotype_layer.note: PGx component markers are paired with gene-level readiness guidance. The resource identifies missing diplotype, phase, CNV, repeat, HLA, enzyme-activity, drug, and clinical inputs without assigning a phenotype, dose, or medication change from raw consumer DNA.

phenotype_prompt_layer.note: Phenotype prompts are selected by manifest pack ID and carry source-registry IDs into the support payload; all user-facing manifest packs except the protected research_found draft container now have a prompt domain. They request observed context and confirmation rather than diagnosing from common DNA markers.

research_taxonomy_layer.note: Discovery keyword routing is shared by the Svelte UI and Rust enrichment path; taxonomy matches are navigation hints and do not upgrade evidence or imply a diagnosis.
